name: glasswing
description: Scan your AI tool settings and see, in plain language, what those tools can reach and what to lock down. Runs only on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: See what your AI tools can reach.
interface.longDescription: Glasswing reads the settings of the AI apps on this computer, lists what each one is able to reach, flags risky permissions and stored credentials, and gives a concrete fix for each. It only reads, and runs only on your computer.
interface.defaultPrompt: Scan my AI tool settings with Glasswing and tell me what to lock down.
